2610.10170.title: Does Document Structure Help Dense Retrieval? A Placebo-Controlled Ablation of Four Mechanisms Across Two Corpora
2610.10170.paper_summary: Retrieval-augmented generation systems increasingly rely on document-structure treatments: structure-aligned chunking, LLM-generated chunk contexts, heading-path metadata, and hierarchical two-stage retrieval. Separate studies support each on different corpora, embedders, and metrics, and none control for a shared confound: any text prepended to a chunk perturbs its embedding. We present a mechanism-isolating ablation testing all four treatments under one protocol, matching chunk sizes across conditions and adding a semantically null placebo---heading paths that are structurally valid but shuffled across documents. We score retrieval with a coverage-aware nDCG and test four pre-registered contrasts via document-clustered bootstrap with Holm correction, on two distant corpora: 200 Wikipedia Featured Articles (951 queries) and 1,585 QASPER papers (4,303 questions). Organization helps, and the cause is content, not tokens: structure-aligned chunks with real heading paths beat contextualized fixed windows (+0.022 / +0.012 cov-nDCG@10) and the placebo (+0.010 / +0.016). Naive two-stage hierarchical retrieval hurts (-0.033 / -0.015), traceable to first-stage section recall. Gold structure beats LLM-induced structure on Wikipedia but not on QASPER. Effects are small ($dz$ 0.06-0.11) but Holm-significant and consistent across corpora.
2610.10170.paper_summary_zh: 檢索增強生成系統越來越依賴於文檔結構處理：結構對齊的分塊、LLM生成的分塊上下文、標題路徑元數據和分層兩階段檢索。不同的研究支持在不同的語料庫、嵌入器和指標上各自的處理，且沒有控制一個共同的混淆變量：任何添加到分塊前的文本都會擾動其嵌入。我們提出了一種機制隔離的消融測試，對所有四種處理在一個協議下進行測試，跨條件匹配分塊大小並添加一個語義上無效的安慰劑——結構上有效但在文檔中隨機排列的標題路徑。我們用考慮覆蓋率的nDCG對檢索進行評分，並通過文檔聚類自助法與Holm校正測試四個預註冊的對比，使用兩個遙遠的語料庫：200篇維基百科特色文章（951個查詢）和1585篇QASPER論文（4303個問題）。組織有助於改善結果，其原因是內容，而非標記：具有真實標題路徑的結構對齊分塊超過了上下文化的固定窗口（+0.022 / +0.012 cov-nDCG@10）和安慰劑（+0.010 / +0.016）。天真的兩階段分層檢索會造成損害（-0.033 / -0.015），可追溯到第一階段的部分回憶。金標準結構在維基百科上優於LLM引起的結構，但在QASPER上則不然。效果較小（$dz$ 0.06-0.11），但在Holm校正下顯著，且在不同語料庫中一致。
